ZHH @ 14 TeV

Process: ZHH — HEFT coefficients A_i (LO: 6-term; NNLO/HHZ: 18-term).
LO fit to sig_LO; NNLO block fit to sig_HHZ.

Companion machine-readable data:
  pdf_alpha_s_covariance.json  — central A_i, PDF/alpha_s deltas and covariances
  scale_coefficients.json      — 7-point scale-refitted A_i (envelope inputs)

=== Uncertainty methods and usage ===

Cross section at arbitrary kappa:
  sigma(kappa) = m(kappa) . A_central

PDF uncertainty on sigma (linear propagation):
  delta_sigma_PDF = sqrt( m^T C_pdf m )
  Source: pdf_alpha_s_covariance.json, C_pdf for LO / HHZ

alpha_s uncertainty on sigma:
  delta_sigma_alpha_s = sqrt( m^T C_alphaS m )
  Source: pdf_alpha_s_covariance.json, C_alphaS for LO / HHZ

Combined PDF + alpha_s uncertainty on sigma:
  delta_sigma_PDF+alpha_s = sqrt( m^T (C_pdf + C_alphaS) m )
                            = sqrt( m^T C_pdf+alphaS m )
  Method: PDF: 40 Gioia replicas (NSET=1..40), C_pdf = sum_n (A^n - A^0)(A^n - A^0)^T; alpha_s: NSET=41,42 at (mu_R, mu_F)=(1,1), delta_alpha_s = (A^42 - A^41)/2, C_alphaS = delta delta^T; combined: C_pdf_alphaS = C_pdf + C_alphaS, delta_pdf_alpha_s = [delta_pdf^2 + delta_alpha_s^2]^(1/2)

Scale uncertainty on sigma (7-point envelope, used by the package):
  Refit A_i at NSET=0 for each (mu_R, mu_F) in
    (0.5,0.5), (1,0.5), (0.5,1), (1,1), (2,1), (1,2), (2,2)
  sigma_s = m(kappa) . A_i(mu_R, mu_F) at each scale point s
  delta_sigma_up   = max_s ( sigma_s - sigma_central )
  delta_sigma_down = max_s ( sigma_central - sigma_s )
  Source: scale_coefficients.json (A_LO_by_scale / A_NNLO_by_scale)

Per-coefficient tables below give envelope half-widths on each A_i
(+scale_env / -scale_env). For sigma at a physical kappa, use the
7-point cross-section envelope above — not sqrt(m^T C_scale m).
